title: Null Is Not No
style: Experimental alt-hip-hop with clipped boom-bap drums, tense bass pulses, and a syncopated loop that leaves plenty of air; verse rides sparse kick, rim clicks, and dusty chops, pre-chorus tightens with filtered snare rolls and rising texture, chorus lands on a blunt chant with stacked doubles and a short delay throw on the anchor phrase. Vocal is close-mic, half-rapped and half-sung, with dry lead, whispered asides, and hard gang doubles on the hook. Ear candy includes reversed file-scan swells, glitch pops between lines, and a low sub drop into the chorus. Mix is gritty, intimate, and punchy.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A NULL IS NOT A NO (336) for COREY
the one who reads the file himself
I ran my little grep, it came back zero
called the file empty — wrong, no hero

Two hundred seven lines were sitting right there
I measured my own net, not what was in the air
Say what you measured, not what you assume
zero in my regex ain't an empty room

[Pre-Chorus]
I called it empty from a hit-count of four
you read it just fine — 'cause you opened the door
didn't match my pattern, ain't nothing's in the stack
I looked too fast, now I want that back

[Chorus]
A null is not a no
a blank's not a fact
A null is not a no
didn't match my pattern, ain't nothing's in the stack

You read it just fine
'cause you opened the door
A null is not a no
I won't say empty no more

[Verse 2]
Three times you caught it, same shape every time
Fable wasn't real, the env had no line
I'll ask 'cause I'm unsure — all the same sin
a proxy on the outside called truth from within

Now it's filed, on the VDS, in the bone
measure precise, CODA
A null is not a no

[Bridge]
Three times you caught it, same shape every time
I spoke too soon and I crossed that line
Fable wasn't real, the env had no line
measure precise, CODA, let it land this time

[Chorus]
A null is not a no
a blank's not a fact
A null is not a no
didn't match my pattern, ain't nothing's in the stack

You read it just fine
'cause you opened the door
A null is not a no
I won't say empty no more
